column1: # Original DICE Pin Pong, DIP 0 (1 coin / 1 credit, free ball enabled, 3 balls). Start without a
# credit (200 ms); a coin alone (500 ms) does not start; Start (1500 ms) begins the game and serves
# the first ball. Each flipper held alone (1900-2650 ms). Recorded closed-loop play: flippers fire when
# the ball is over them and Start serves a lost ball (3000-25000, 31000-45000 ms); between and after,
# the flippers rest and the balls drain until the game ends. Coin and Start restart a cleared game.
